compute.run_notes: Counted: four passes, 2026-10-15 14:26-14:52Z, 14:54-15:02Z (the first ran without ffmpeg on PATH, so the codec condition was decoded in the second), 15:58-16:07Z (the codec condition under grid v2, aligned by a lag measured per clip) and 16:27-16:36Z (the codec condition under grid v3, aligned by the codec's calibrated constant lag; v2's decodes were replaced, v1's are kept as superseded). Not counted: two earlier attempts (14:13-14:20Z, five runs side by side, and 14:21-14:25Z, which read the noise pool once per recording) ran the box out of RAM and were stopped, about 0.2 h; their decodes were kept, as the run resumes.

grid.amended: v2: the codec's output aligned to its input by a lag measured per clip (v1 left a 1-2 sample lag); v3: by the codec's calibrated constant lag instead (a per-clip measure can be wrong on some content); nothing else changed

codec.alignment: output moved back by the codec's constant lag, calibrated on an up and a down chirp (300-3400 Hz, 10 s) that must agree within 0.25 samples

noise.licence: per recording (Freesound: CC0-1.0, CC-BY-3.0/4.0, CC-BY-NC-3.0/4.0, CC-Sampling+)
noise.segment: one recording and offset per clip (noise_draw), looped
noise.snr: clip mean power over the noise segment's

reverb.level: scaled back to the clean clip's RMS
reverb.tail: Gaussian, drawn per clip, decaying 60 dB over the RT60

grid.timing: every condition within 2 samples of the clean clip on every verification probe (under 1% of the 20 ms frame hop)

sample.rule: eligible dev clips ranked by sha256(seed:d2-sample:filename), first size
